messages:
maria_ng: Quick sync — need final copy + assets for the gated webinar social push. Webinar is Friday 10am PT. Plan = teaser thread on X, single post on LinkedIn, registration nudge, and post-webinar highlight thread + benchmark narrative. Who can own assets + CTA link?
jamal_marketing: I can own the X thread. Need 3 assets: hero image, 30s clip, quote card. Can we get by Wed EOD? :calendar:
zoe_growth: Design overloaded this week. Can we compress to Thu morning? OR trim to hero + quote card for the teaser so we can hit Wed for scheduling.
maria_ng: Trim is fine — prioritize hero + 1 quote card. Jamal: please draft 4–5 opener variants for A/B, keep under ~140 chars.
jamal_marketing: Will do. I'll post first two variations by Thu noon for review. Suggest CTA: "Save your seat" + short link (rwd.in/webinar).
ryan_ops: For inbound routing — gate registration with company + email and add lead tag `webinar-mar-10`. Then forward to sales queue for follow-up. Can we do HubSpot workflow?
ana_sales: (typo correction) ana_sales: Yup. I'll build a sequence: immediate thank-you email, 24h reminder, day-of reminder, and post-webinar replay + qualification ping to SDRs. Sequence name: "Webinar — Mar 10 — Redwood".
ryan_ops: HubSpot workflow plan:
```
Trigger: form submit (webinar-mar-10)
Actions:
 - add contact to list: webinar-mar-10-attendees
 - set contact property: source = social
 - notify owner: round-robin to sales-queue
 - enqueue sequence: webinar-nurture-3step
```
zoe_growth: Nice. For LinkedIn copy — let's keep more professional tone, one stat/benchmark callout in the post. Jamal, can you draft that too?
jamal_marketing: Yep. LinkedIn draft + 2 headline variants by Thu as well.
maria_ng: Scheduling windows: teaser X on Wed 9am PT, LinkedIn single post Thu 11am PT, final X push Fri 6am PT (day-of), post-webinar highlight Mon 10am PT. Any conflicts?
post_bot: Available social slots updated: Wed 09:00 PT, Thu 11:00 PT, Fri 06:00 PT, Mon 10:00 PT. Use tag `#event` for analytics.
zoe_growth: Small ask — can we include benchmark narrative as 1–2 bullets in the post-webinar highlight? e.g., "avg latency down 3x" or similar. Need concrete numbers from product. @maria_ng can you get a line from engineering?
maria_ng: I'll get a stat from eng by Thu morning. If not, we'll use qualitative phrasing.
nana_sales: ana_sales: FYI — please add UTM params to registration link so we can attribute leads to channel. utm_source=x_social / linkedin / thread.
jamal_marketing: Good call. I'll add UTMs and short links. Example: https://rwd.in/webinar-mar10?utm_source=x_teaser
zoe_growth: For engagement follow-ups — plan: 1) auto DM registrants 24h after sign-up with calendar link, 2) post 1hr highlights clip to X within 2 hours after webinar. Can ops support quick clip upload?
ryan_ops: We'll export the 30s clip and upload. Ops will also enable priority CDN for replay assets.
maria_ng: Last check — who approves final copy? Approvers: @zoe_growth (PR tone) + @maria_ng (product messaging). Once approved, jamal, you can queue posts.
jamal_marketing: Got it. I'll queue after approvals. Will post first draft Thursday noon. :thumbsup:
zoe_growth: Thumbs up. Anything else?
nana_sales: ana_sales: I'll prep the HubSpot list & notification rules tonight. Ping me if you want demo-ready leads flagged.
maria_ng: Thanks everyone — ping if timeline slips. I'll drop the registration link here once live: https://rwd.in/webinar-mar10
post_bot: Thread reminder scheduled in 24h to check assets. :robot_face:
